store.closed: After the player completes the Community Center

membership.name: JojaMart Membership
membership.description: Morris offers it in the kiosk at the bottom right of the store once the Community Center is unlocked. It turns the Community Center into a Joja Warehouse, and the projects below replace the bundles. Prices match Pierre's afterwards (Sunflower Seeds are 100g).

facts: JojaMart is open until 11pm and on Wednesdays, when Pierre's is closed.
Without a membership its prices are usually worse than Pierre's.
Only one project can be bought per day: the Joja Warehouse is built the day after the membership, then one project per day.
It is closed on festival days, except the Desert Festival, Trout Derby, SquidFest, Night Market and the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies.

Shane stocks shelves from 8:00 to 5:00 on weekdays, and on weekends when it rains. Sam sweeps from 12:50 to 5:00 on Mondays and Wednesdays. You cannot talk to them while they work, unless you give a gift.

projects.name: Minecarts
projects.description: Repairs the minecart system between the bus stop, the mountains and Pelican Town.

projects.name: Panning
projects.description: Removes the glimmering boulder near the mine entrance.

projects.name: Bridge
projects.description: Repairs the broken bridge east of the Mines, giving access to the Quarry.

projects.name: Greenhouse
projects.description: Repairs the old ruins on the farm into a greenhouse.

projects.name: Bus
projects.description: Repairs the bus that runs to the Calico Desert.

notSold: General items: Bouquet, Catalogue and the Grass Starter Recipe.
Seeds: Corn Seeds in Summer (both stores have them in Fall), Garlic Seeds, Rice Shoot, Blueberry Seeds, Red Cabbage Seeds, Artichoke Seeds.
Fertilizers: Basic and Quality Fertilizer, Basic and Quality Retaining Soil, Speed-Gro and Deluxe Speed-Gro.
Fruit tree saplings: Cherry, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Pomegranate and Apple.
Pierre's is the only place to buy out-of-season seeds.
tips: The Joja Co. Member Of The Year achievement needs every project, which takes at least six days.
Seed prices are higher than Pierre's until you buy the membership, except Sunflower Seeds (125g here, 200g at Pierre's).
If the Community Center is completed instead, Sam goes to work at the Museum and Shane becomes unemployed.
